horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: De cómo se crió Yarocomena. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: V13 — Kïtobeni: aspecto transformado. 
Reference 2: H01-55 — Kïtobeo y hermana de Kïtobeni. Kïtobeo father: SHORT emerald/charcoal feather ring with ONE golden accent, sparse six cream tooth-shape PAPER pendants / red-black seeds, short cream raw-fibre hip wrap with BIG black FRONT diagonals, one small pale nose quill, broad lined face and long grey-black hair. Sister: bare head, straight black blunt chin hair, cream KNEE-length garment with RED triangular neck trim and uneven ochre hem, red/black seed choker, small cobalt EAR feather tuft, no nose ornament.
Reference 3: L08-55 — Casa de parientes de Kïtobeni. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide quiet raw-fibre secluded maloca room in cool dawn light. ONE whole young adult Kïtobeni in the transformed appearance V13 sits modestly clothed inside a simple hanging fibre screen; ONE whole sister selected from H01-55 opens the screen early from the side. Paper feathers and pigment accents around the young man's shoulders are still unfinished lifted pieces, not floating mystical cosmetics or another body. One relation: interruption leaves a visible unfinished seam in the original preparation. No real diet recipe, magical named Kirurue body, sexual encounter, captive gore or modern salon. Full bodies and screen inside, quiet space dominates.

VISIBLE CHECK: Kïtobeni completo en preparación; su hermana abre una pantalla todavía cerrada.

Kïtobeo father: SHORT emerald/charcoal feather ring with ONE golden accent, sparse six cream tooth-shape PAPER pendants / red-black seeds, short cream raw-fibre hip wrap with BIG black FRONT diagonals, one small pale nose quill, broad lined face and long grey-black hair. Reference 2: L11 — Yarokamena · árbol formidable. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Tall deep emerald forest at evening with one small clearing. ONE whole father Kïtobeo from H01-55 kneels and places a small non-anatomical AMBER PAPER HEART-SEED gently into an earthen opening. From that same point ONE extraordinary TREE ROOT begins to rise and unfold toward a vast young trunk above. Original restrained narrative visualization of the preserved heart giving rise to the tree. No realistic severed heart, blood, corpse, sexual violence, weapons, boy resurrecting or identity swap with brother heroes. Entire father, whole heart-seed and beginning root fit; the tall paper tree continues toward canopy and conveys consequence.

VISIBLE CHECK: Padre entero deposita corazón-semillla y de su lugar se despliega una raíz.

MYTH: De cómo se crió Yarocomena. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: L11 — Yarokamena · árbol formidable. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE warm amber non-anatomical HEART-SHAPED PAPER SEED is partly enclosed by a single great charcoal/ochre TREE ROOT KNOT. The heart's own lifted upper seam extends upward as a new trunk, so seed, grief and growth are one continuous carrier. Root tips spread far wider than the little seed, visually suggesting that a private loss has consequences beyond its beginning. Original editorial metaphor for Kïtobeni's preserved heart becoming Yarokamena. No animal worm, heroes, blood, anatomical organ, weapons, funeral rite or competing symbol. Intimate full-bleed deep green night ground; strong amber/charcoal tactile contrast.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un corazón-semilla se vuelve un nudo de raíces que excede su tamaño.
